name: Single-Arm Cable Overhead Triceps Extension
summary: An isolation exercise that trains the triceps, particularly the long head, by extending the elbow overhead against high cable resistance.

setup: Set the cable pulley to a high position and attach a single D-handle or use the bare cable ball.
Grasp the handle with one hand and face directly away from the cable stack.
Step forward into a stable staggered stance, leaning slightly forward at the hips to allow clearance for the cable.
Position your upper arm elevated alongside your head, elbow bent with your hand positioned behind your head.
steps: Keep your upper arm stationary while extending through the elbow to press the cable forward and overhead.
Squeeze your triceps firmly at full elbow extension without locking out harshly.
Control the handle back behind your head by bending the elbow through a deep stretch.
Complete the set, then repeat for the same number of repetitions on the opposite arm.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you extend the elbow, and inhale as you return under control.
cues: Feel the stretch at the bottom

common_faults.fault: Flaring the elbow excessively or letting the upper arm drift forward and backward.
common_faults.correction: Keep your upper arm stabilized alongside your head throughout the entire repetition.

common_faults.fault: Arching the lower back to compensate for heavy weight.
common_faults.correction: Brace your core and maintain a firm staggered stance with a forward torso lean.

precautions: Control the cable tension when turning into and out of the starting position to protect the shoulder joint.
